Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Line Leader (m/f/d).

What your job includes

As a Line Leader, you are responsible for the daily operation of a production line. You make sure production runs safely, on time, and according to quality standards. You lead a team of operators, support them during the shift, and help solve any issues on the line.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and support a team of production employees and operators
- Make sure production targets are met
- Check product quality, food safety, hygiene, and safety standards
- Ensure correct product labels and production records
- Solve minor machine or production issues and report larger problems
- Keep the production area clean, safe, and organized
- Look for ways to improve the production process

What we expect from you

- MBO Level 3 working and thinking level
- Experience in a production or food manufacturing environment
- Experience as a team leader or supervisor is an advantage
- Knowledge of HACCP is a plus
- Good communication skills
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift system (5:30-15:00 and 15:00-23:30)
- A valid working permit for the Netherlands

What We Offer

- A competitive monthly salary (based on a 36-hour work week), depending on your knowledge and experience
- A fixed-term contract with the opportunity for a permanent contract
- 24 vacation days per year
- An 8% holiday allowance
- A 3.25% year-end bonus
- A comprehensive pension plan through VLEP
- A future-focused working environment
- Opportunities for training, personal development, and career growth
- A supportive team in an international production environment
- A monthly salary of min. 2555€

Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Buyer (m/f/d).

What your job includes

As a Buyer, you are responsible for purchasing and calling off products, materials, and services for the factory from suppliers, manufacturers, and wholesalers both domestically and internationally. You maintain good relationships with suppliers and monitor their performance.

- Daily processing of purchase proposals and orders for raw materials and goods
- Organizing the local purchasing and ordering process
- Determining and organizing delivery times, order quantities, and order schedules
- Monitoring and checking the nature, quantity, and quality of the ordered goods
- Handling and following up on complaints when delivered goods do not meet expectations
- Maintaining master data related to purchasing-relevant information
- Performing other tasks as directed by the supervisor

What we expect from you

- Strong coordination and organizational skills 
- Good negotiation skills, a professional demeanor, and persuasiveness
- Analytical insight
- Creative and solution-oriented mindset
- Good team spirit and ability to collaborate
- Excellent skills in MS Office and ERP systems
- Fluency in English and Dutch

What We Offer You

We are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.

- A responsible role within the purchasing and ordering process
- A professional work environment where you collaborate with various internal and external parties
- A position with international contacts with suppliers
- A work environment where accuracy, organization, and collaboration are central

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

About Benchmark:

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.

Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.

Welding Robot Operator

The company is looking for a Welding Robot Operator for the robotics department. In this role, you will be responsible for the automated welding process of high-quality stainless steel welded assemblies and will also perform various metalworking tasks. You will work in a production team with one or more welding robots, assessing and reworking products as needed. As a robot operator, you will monitor the functioning of the welding robots and the welding quality. The welds will be visually inspected, and any deviations will be monitored and discussed to ensure continuous process improvement. The plate thickness varies between 2 and 5 mm.
Team
There are different products: box frames, center arms, fences and grates, central units and boiler frames, collectors, M4use.
 What Will You Be Doing? 
▪ Operating and configuring the welding robot 
▪ Monitoring product quality 
▪ Improvement
What skills Do You need?
▪ You can weld in both Mig/Mag and Tig modes.
▪ Experience with welding robots.
▪ You are fluent in English.
▪ You are motivated and can work accurately.

    Salary between 20-21 euros gross/hour for 38 hours/week. With overtime (depending on client’s requirement): You can earn between 700-800 euros net/week (excluding housing and health insurance).
    Single Private Room in shared house

AT The Family Business:

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior Database Administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.

Who are you?

Skills & competences:

 
• Conscientiousness
 
• Motivation and positive mindset
 
• Ability to work independently
 
• Quick learning and strong organizational skills
 
• Excellent verbal and written communication
 
• Customer-centric approach
 
• Teamwork
 
• Willingness to ask difficult questions
 
• Professionalism
 
• Transparency and solution orientation

 

Preferred qualifications:

 
• Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.
 
• Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.
 
• Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.
 
• Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.
 
• Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.
 
• Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.
 
• Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.
 
• Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.
 
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.
 
• Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.

What will you do?

 
• Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.
 
• Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.
 
• Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.
 
• Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.
 
• Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.
 
• Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.
 
• Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
 
• Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.
 
• Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and...
...
-
